```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library( "DESeq2" )
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
metadata <- read_csv("ColDataFinaloutliergone2.csv")
Count_Data <- read.csv("Count_Data_MDD_ourliergone2.csv", row.names = 1, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)
metadata$ID <- factor(metadata$ID)
metadata$Treatment <- factor(metadata$Treatment)
metadata$PHQ9_Change <- metadata$EX_PHQ_9 - metadata$Baseline_PHQ_9

# Filter for subjects with at least 3 treatment timepoints 
library(dplyr)
complete_IDs <- metadata %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(Treatment) >= 3) %>%
  pull(ID) %>%
  unique()

# Subset colData
colData_filtered <- metadata[metadata$ID %in% complete_IDs, ]

# Subset countData to match
countData_filtered <- Count_Data[, colnames(Count_Data) %in% colData_filtered$Sample_ID]

# Make sure the columns are in the same order
colData_filtered <- colData_filtered[match(colnames(countData_filtered), colData_filtered$Sample_ID), ]

countData_filtered <- as.matrix(Count_Data[, colnames(Count_Data) %in% colData_filtered$Sample_ID])
mode(countData_filtered) <- "numeric"

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = countData_filtered,
                              colData = colData_filtered,
                              design = ~ ID + Treatment)
dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds)
dds <- estimateDispersions(dds)
idx <- rowSums( counts(dds, normalized=TRUE) >= 5 ) >= 3
dds$Treatment <- relevel(dds$Treatment, ref = "PRE")
dds <- dds[idx,]
dds <- nbinomWaldTest(dds, maxit = 1000)
results_Post_vs_Pre <- results(dds, contrast = c("Treatment","POST","PRE"))
resFilt <- results_Post_vs_Pre[which(results_Post_vs_Pre$pvalue < 0.05), ]
resnaomit <- na.omit(resFilt)
write.csv(resnaomit, file="MDD_Mid_PRE_Contrast.csv")

# get n number per group
table(colData(dds)$Treatment)
```

PCA Plot
```{r}
library(ggrepel)
# Perform PCA on the variance-stabilized or rlog-transformed counts
rlog <- rlog(dds, blind=FALSE)  # Alternative: rld <- rlog(dds, blind=FALSE)
# Extract PCA data
pcaData <- plotPCA(rlog, intgroup="Treatment", returnData=TRUE)
percentVar <- round(100 * attr(pcaData, "percentVar"), 1)
# Define custom colors for conditions
custom_colors <- c("PRE" = "darkgreen", "POST" = "darkblue")

# Define outlier threshold (e.g., top 2% extreme values)
threshold_PC1 <- quantile(abs(pcaData$PC1), 0.98)  # Adjust as needed
threshold_PC2 <- quantile(abs(pcaData$PC2), 0.98)  # Adjust as needed
# Identify outliers based on extreme PC1 or PC2 values
outliers <- pcaData[abs(pcaData$PC1) > threshold_PC1 | abs(pcaData$PC2) > threshold_PC2, ]

# Plot PCA with ggplot2, color by "Run" and shape by "Stress"
PCA_Plot <- ggplot(pcaData, aes(PC1, PC2, color = Treatment)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(data = outliers, aes(label = name), size = 5, box.padding = 0.5) +  # Label only outliers 
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "PCA Plot",
       x = paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "% variance"),
       y = paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "% variance")) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())
```

## Identifying ouliers
```{r}
install.packages("isotree")
library(isotree)
norm_counts <- counts(dds, normalized = TRUE)
sample_matrix <- t(norm_counts)

# Apply Isolation Forest
iso_model <- isolation.forest(sample_matrix, ntrees = 100)
outlier_scores <- predict(iso_model, sample_matrix, type = "score")

# Label outliers (e.g., top 5%)
threshold <- quantile(outlier_scores, 0.95)
outlier_samples <- which(outlier_scores >= threshold)

# View results
outlier_sample_names <- rownames(sample_matrix)[outlier_samples]

# removed 352_E6, 373_E1, 373_E6, 413_E6, 438_E1, 438E6

```

Heatmap 
```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(DESeq2)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)

# ---- 1. Get DESeq2 results with unadjusted p-value ≤ 0.05 ----
res <- results(dds)
sig_genes <- rownames(res)[which(res$pvalue <= 0.05 & !is.na(res$pvalue))]

# ---- 2. Extract log2-normalized counts ----
log_counts <- log2(counts(dds, normalized = TRUE) + 1)

# Subset to significant genes only
sig_log_counts <- log_counts[sig_genes, ]

# ---- 3. Order samples by condition ----
# Define condition order explicitly
condition_order <- c("PRE", "MID", "POST", "75 min POST")

# Extract condition info
condition <- colData(dds)$Treatment
names(condition) <- colnames(dds)

# Order columns (samples) by condition
ordered_samples <- names(condition)[order(factor(condition, levels = condition_order))]
sig_log_counts <- sig_log_counts[, ordered_samples]

# ---- 4. Prepare column annotations ----
annotation_col <- data.frame(
  Condition = factor(condition[ordered_samples], levels = condition_order)
)
rownames(annotation_col) <- ordered_samples

# ---- 5. Generate the heatmap ----
pheatmap(
  sig_log_counts,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,              # Cluster genes
  cluster_cols = FALSE,             # Don't cluster samples
  annotation_col = annotation_col,  # Show condition labels
  show_rownames = FALSE,            # Hide gene names (optional)
  fontsize_col = 10,
  scale = "row",                    # Z-score scale across genes
  color = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(9, "RdBu")))(255)
)
```
